name: Card-to-card connector
visual_intent: One card hands off to another along a drawn curved arrow.

parameters.name: a, b
parameters.description: Elements to join (measured at the cue)

parameters.name: axis
parameters.description: Force 'x' or 'y' instead of the dominant axis

parameters.name: bend
parameters.description: Control-point reach as a share of the distance

timeline_requirements.gsap_instance: Timeline passed to Studio.build(builder) (registered as window.__timelines['root'])
timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: After both cards have landed; the connector should not move once drawn

code_snippet.javascript:
var layer = Studio.draw.layer('#s2');
Studio.draw.connect(tl, layer, '#machineA', '#bucket', 3.2, { bend: 0.35 });

fallbacks: Static SVG arrow faded in with autoAlpha.

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test tests/studio-runtime/reference-techniques.html in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
